intro.title: Rooted in Warmth
intro.body: Step into a space made for unhurried breakfasts, generous lunches and coffee worth lingering over. Our kitchen follows the market, keeping plates simple, seasonal and full of comfort.

manifesto.title: From Plot to Plate
manifesto.body: Great food starts with good relationships. We buy from nearby growers, bakers and makers, then keep the cooking honest so every cup and plate feels connected to the people behind it.

testimonials.title: Words from Our Community
testimonials.backgroundAlt: Cosy restaurant dining room in warm evening light

items.quote: The room is peaceful, the coffee is exacting, and the greens on toast are the reason I cross town.
items.author: Imogen Price

items.quote: It feels like a proper neighbourhood table. Thoughtful food, gentle service and no fuss.
items.author: Caleb Morgan

items.quote: You can taste the care in everything they serve. I bring clients here because it always feels easy.
items.author: Nadia Ellis

about.title: Our Story
about.intro: Moss & Marrow began as a small counter serving coffee to market traders before sunrise.
about.body: Today we are still led by the same idea: cook what is close, serve it with care, and make the room feel calm enough for real conversation.
